name: & OTHER STORIES
description: \& Other Stories is a fashion brand launched in 2013, offering women diverse collections of ready-to-wear, shoes, accessories, and beauty designed in Paris, Stockholm, and Los Angeles. The brand has over 70 physical stores in 24 markets, including Europe, the US, the Middle East and Asia.

name: BUCCELLATI
description: Renowned as the "Prince of Goldsmiths," the Milanese Maison brings over a century of heritage and unparalleled craftsmanship to the heart of Singapore's premier luxury destination. Stepping into the Buccellati boutique is an invitation to witness a legacy where jewellery transcends ornament to become wearable art. Every piece is a testament to the family's devotion to Renaissance-inspired techniques---from the iconic Rigato engraving that gives gold the sheen of silk, to the delicate Tulle "honeycomb" work that mimics the finest lace.

name: BUBEN & ZORWEG
description: Buben \& Zorweg is a top German luxury brand specializing in watch winders, safe and multi-functional objects. Its design and function delight and excite collectors worldwide who are looking for luxury devices to protect, store, and showcase their precious collections.

name: HERMÈS (HERMES)
description: Since 1837, Hermès has remained faithful to its artisanal model and human values. The freedom to create, the constant quest for beautiful materials, the transmission of exceptional know-how, right down to details designed with use in mind -- or the aesthetics of function -- all forge the uniqueness of the house, creator of objects designed to last.

name: JAEGER-LECOULTRE
description: Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers™, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing over 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison's watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication.

name: CHALLENGER B3
description: Singapore's homegrown electronics chain since 1982 is bringing the convenience and range of the latest IT gadgets and lifestyle essentials to shoppers at ION Orchard. Trusted by over half a million members, shop confidently across tech favourites like Apple, Samsung, Lenovo and more.

name: LANCOME (LANCÔME)
description: Founded in 1935 by Armand Petitjean, Lancôme stands as the premier ambassador of French luxury, blending nearly a century of heritage with avant-garde scientific innovation. At its core, Lancôme operates on the philosophy that beauty is a functional expression of happiness, driving a commitment to products that empower rather than just conceal.

name: 1855 THE BOTTLE SHOP
description: A three-time recipient of Singapore Tatler's Best Wine Retailer award from 2017 to 2019, 1855 The Bottle Shop is Singapore's leading specialist wine and spirit retailer, a place crafted for wine and spirit enthusiasts from novices to oenophiles. With over 1,000 premium labels at your fingertips, discover a curated collection of fine pours from all over the world, many of which retail exclusively at 1855 The Bottle Shop. Fuelled by a passion for oenological discoveries, we specially handpick an intriguing and robust selection for discerning patrons. You will find a fitting bottle for every palate and occasion on our shelves -- from the revered classics of the great Bordeaux châteaux, to the contemporary icons of modern wineries -- with personalised recommendations to help you select the perfect bottle.

name: A. LANGE & SOHNE
description: For several generations, the watchmakers of A. Lange \& Söhne have been pursuing one goal: to craft timepieces that represent the pinnacle of international watchmaking artistry. Each of the watches are Made in Germany at the manufactory in Glashütte, crafted by hand and renowned for their reliability through excellent mechanics.

name: ADIDAS
description: Welcome to adidas Singapore. Shop from classic adidas styles to the freshest new shoes, clothing, activewear, sportswear and more.

name: AESOP
description: Aesop was established in 1987. Our objective has always been to formulate skin, hair and body care products of the finest quality; we investigate widely to source plant-based and laboratory-made ingredients, and use only those with a proven record of safety and efficacy.

name: ALDO
description: ALDO creates the perfect mix of stylish, comfortable, well-made, and accessibly priced footwear, handbags and accessories for whatever you've got going on in life. And ALDO does it with a lot of heart. As a global fashion company, we enable genuine self-expression and feel-good style, while actively supporting the social issues that impact our communities.

name: MCQUEEN
description: McQueen is a British luxury fashion house founded by Lee Alexander McQueen in 1992. In 2001, the house joined the Kering Group and, since December 2023, is under the creative direction of Seán McGirr. McQueen is distinctive for an expression of individuality, subversive strength and raw power. With a design studio and atelier based in London, the house is known for uncompromising quality and creative vision.

name: ALUXE JEWELRY
description: As the leading jewelry brand in Taiwan, ALUXE embodies the perfect combination of happiness and jewelry. Whether you are experiencing a wonderful relationship, expressing your feelings to your loved one, or wanting to pamper yourself, ALUXE looks forward to offering you the perfect experience.

name: AlX ARMANI EXCHANGE
description: A\|X Armani Exchange is shaped by street-chic culture and freedom of expression. The brand's creations are led by Italian designer Giorgio Armani, who draws from his unique style to create a casual, yet sophisticated collection for the young, urban and sexy.

name: APM MONACO
description: It started with a female founder and her son in Monaco, Monte-Carlo, 1982. Ariane and Philippe Prette were key manufacturers in gold, diamonds, and other precious stones for acclaimed jewelers around the world. APM jewelry is chic. APM is Monaco, synonymous with elegance, savoir-vivre, and luxury living. APM jewelry is fashion-forward. APM is street style, catwalks, trends, art. APM is smiling in the South of France. A lifestyle represented by a positive attitude, a sense of welcoming, simplicity, and kindness.

name: ASICS
description: ASICS has been developing sports footwear and apparel for more than 50 years. In this time, innovation has been the key to their introduction of design philosophies that have revolutionised the world of sports. At ASICS's research and development centre in Kobe, Japan, they work in close collaboration with male and female athletes. Through their scientific approach, ASICS has strived to create highly innovative sports product solutions that their customers rely upon. Technologies, such as core GEL cushioning system and Flytefoam are renowned for enabling the most comfortable and performance-enhancing footwear and apparel on the market, for athletes and active consumers alike.

name: BACCARAT
description: Founded in 1764, Baccarat, alchemist of joy and creator of enchanting worlds, is the fruit of a group of daring artisans who have transformed the four elements of nature -- earth, air, fire and water -- into crystal of unparalleled purity. By crafting true masterpieces, Baccarat has never ceased to surprise the world, garnering numerous awards at World Fairs and international exhibitions. This is how the name of a small town in eastern France, Baccarat, has over time become a symbol of the art of celebration and French joie de vivre. From Paris to Moscow, New York, Tokyo, Miami or Singapore, the unique experience of Baccarat's art de vivre can be found within its Maisons, boutiques, restaurants, bars and hotels. Discover Baccarat creations at ION Orchard, handcrafted with passion to bring light, pleasure, and joy.

name: BATH & BODY WORKS
description: We make the world a brighter, happier place through the power of fragrance. Bath \& Body Works is a global leader in personal care and home fragrance, including #1 selling collections for fine fragrance mist, body lotion and body cream, 3-wick candles, home fragrance diffusers and liquid hand soap.

name: BENJAMIN BARKER
description: A modern-day gentlemen's outfitter. Benjamin Barker is a purveyor of smart-casual, heritage inspired apparel and a lifestyle destination for the discerning gentleman. Weaving the art of living into the fabric of life. Experience the #BenjaminBarker lifestyle at ION Orchard #B3-34 today.

name: BEYOND THE VINES
description: Established in 2015 by Singaporean husband-and-wife duo Daniel Chew and Rebecca Ting, Beyond The Vines is a contemporary brand founded on the belief that good design should be accessible to all. The label embraces minimalistic design sensibilities with a refined approach drawing from a philosophy inspired by duality -- to create boldly, and to design simply. The core of the brand's vision and inspiration comes from keeping with the pulse of contemporary culture and the natural atmosphere -- to find strength where differences exist.

name: BIMBA Y LOLA
description: BIMBA Y LOLA is a creative collective. A multidisciplinary group of people spreading art and culture through fashion. We believe in creativity and its power to shape a better world. Creativity for external and internal use only. Creativity for each and everyone. Deeply fresh, seriously playful. From Spain to the world. Vigo, 2005.

name: BIRKENSTOCK
description: INVENTOR OF THE FOOTBED Creating products that make customers' lives easier and better. The core product is a unique, anatomically shaped footbed. BIRKENSTOCK invented the footbed and has defined the meaning of the term, which is now widely recognised. The footbed is not only a revolutionary product concept that pioneered a completely new market; it is also a core idea and the foundation of everything done, now and in the future. The belief is that everyone should have access to this footbed.

name: BLANCPAIN
description: Founded in 1735 by Jehan-Jacques Blancpain in the Swiss Jura, Blancpain is known as the world's oldest watch Brand. Loyal to its tradition of innovation and confirmed by countless horological complications invented over the years, the Maison is constantly pushing the boundaries of watchmaking to take this art to places where it has never been before. Embodying a long-term vision, this commitment to the revival of mechanical horology is expressed through the passing on of invaluable expertise from one generation to the next, along with regular investments in human resources, production technologies and research \& development.

name: BOBBI BROWN
description: The secret to beauty is simple: "be who you are". Steeped in the belief that a woman is most beautiful when she looks and feels like herself, Bobbi Brown brings out her confidence with universally-flattering makeup that enhances her features. When empowered with the right tools and a little know-how, every woman can look her best.

name: BRAUN BUFFEL
description: For over a century, Braun Büffel has remained an emblem of style, strength, and dependability, transcending its humble beginnings as a family trade in Kirn, Germany to become a renowned symbol of global recognition. With each meticulously crafted creation, Braun Büffel exemplifies unwavering craftsmanship, timeless appeal, and a rich legacy of excellence that continues to define the brand.

name: BREGUET
description: Since its founding in 1775, Breguet has upheld its unique position in watchmaking history with its values of beauty, elegance and mastery of "grand complications". Incepted by Abraham-Louis Breguet, the honourable Swiss watchmaker is today known for its watches, clocks and jewellery. Its founder made history in the world of horology with his fundamental discoveries, including his invention and manufacture of the world's first self-winding watch in 1780. Breguet designed this fine timepiece complete with an automatic winding rotor and shock-protection mechanism -- the most time-consuming and sophisticated innovation in history.

name: BVLGARI
description: Part of the LVMH Group, Bvlgari was founded in the heart of Rome in 1884. Over the decades, the Brand has established a worldwide reputation as magnificent Roman High Jeweler and icon of Italian art of living thanks to its exquisite craftsmanship, visionary design and audacious color combinations. Through a pioneering vision intrinsic in the brand's DNA since its founding, the company's international success has evolved into a global and diversified luxury purveyor of products and services, ranging from fine jewels and high-end watches to accessories and perfumes, and featuring an extended network of boutiques and hotels in the world's most exclusive shopping areas.

name: BY INVITE ONLY
description: Founded in 2009, By Invite Only is a jewellery brand dedicated to creating jewellery that speaks your heart. The brand's pieces are carefully crafted with intention, serving as intangible symbols of the connections that matter most to you.

name: CALVIN KLEIN
description: Calvin Klein multi-brand lifestyle store is a design concept that brings together the different product lines in one space, housing Calvin Klein Jeans, Calvin Klein Performance, and Calvin Klein Underwear all together for a one-stop retail experience.

name: CARTIER
description: A reference in the world of luxury, Cartier, whose name is synonymous with open-mindedness and curiosity, stands out with its creations and reveals beauty wherever it may lie. Jewellery, high jewellery, watchmaking and fragrances, leather goods and accessories: Cartier's creations symbolize the convergence between exceptional craftsmanship and a timeless signature. Today, Cartier is part of the Richemont Group and has a worldwide presence through its network of flagships and boutiques, authorised retail partners, and online.

name: CASETIFY STUDIO
description: CASETiFY is a global tech and lifestyle brand with double headquarters in LA and Hong Kong, known as the home to the first and largest platform for customized tech accessories. CASETiFY STUDiO provides a one-stop, visual retail experience where customers can customize their accessories on the spot.

name: CELINE
description: Conceived as a timeless and sophisticated space, Celine's ION Orchard boutique is dedicated to women's and men's collections including ready to wear, leathergoods, accessories and haute parfumerie \& beauty lines. The store features an exclusive facade made of curved glass and calacatta oyster marble and integrates on the inside the architectural design concept juxtaposing natural stones such as basaltina and marble, to warmer elements like oak, brass and antique gold mirrors. In continuity with the existing Celine art project, a wall-mounted sculpture by Dutch artist machteld rullens is on display.

name: CHALLENGER
description: Singapore's homegrown electronics chain since 1982 is bringing the convenience and range of the latest IT gadgets and lifestyle essentials to shoppers at ION Orchard. Trusted by over half a million members, shop confidently across tech favourites like Apple, Samsung, Lenovo and more.

name: CHANEL
description: Gabrielle Chanel devoted her life to creating a new allure, in constant quest of freedom of movement. From the little black dress to the iconic handbag and the emblematic tweed suit, CHANEL creations define a timeless silhouette, reinvented season after season.

name: CHANEL
description: The CHANEL Beauty Boutique combines two distinct spaces - the CHANEL Beauty Studio and a discovery area created to immerse one in the CHANEL beauty universe. Discover the full range of CHANEL makeup, fragrance and skincare through a new experiential journey. Designed with two entrances, the space reinterprets the aesthetics and codes of the House via the signature tones of black and white, with a touch of gold. Clean, understated lines subtly define several distinct worlds of makeup, fragrance, skincare, and in-boutique exclusives. Dedicated to offering clients an elegant and modern look, a comprehensive selection of CHANEL sunglasses, adds a unique dimension to the boutique experience.

name: CHANEL PRIVE
description: Because beauty begins with a way of looking at yourself and grows with your self-confidence, Chanel invites you into the heart of an enveloping space devoted to your beauty. Understated, private and refined. A place where you will experience precious moments that unite a voluptuous, instant, sensory pleasure and effective personalised treatments. Let Chanel take care of you and reveal your beauty.

name: CHARLES & KEITH
description: Established in 1996, CHARLES \& KEITH is a Singaporean fashion label that creates collections -- shoes, bags, eyewear, accessories, and costume jewellery -- that enhance life and work. The brand celebrates the joy of fashion and embraces its natural duality: Asian \& Global. Night \& Day. Work \& Play.

name: CHAUMET
description: The history of Chaumet has been entwined with the History of France ever since its founding in 1780, in Paris. Crafted at the very heart of the place Vendôme for more than 240 years, the jewellery and watchmaking creations reflect its exceptional skills and pay tribute to the Parisian style.

name: CHEAK
description: cheak is the sister brand of Love, Bonito and shares the joint mission of empowering the modern Asian woman. cheak creates fashion forward women's activewear, designed to intentionally move with women from the barre room, to the board room. Made with luxe performance fabrics that are comfortably soft, wicks sweat and keeps cool, cheak's versatile activewear designs are created to keep you moving, in the studio and in life.

name: CHOMEL
description: Chomel is an established fashion jewelry and accessories brand in Singapore for over 20 years. Chomel philosophy is to offer contemporary quality accessories at affordable prices to women of all ages.

name: CHOPARD
description: Since its founding in 1860, Chopard has been crafting creations exuding contemporary charm, synonymous with ethics and emotions, while perpetuating a heritage rich in tradition and artisanal savoir-faire. Driven by a positive vision of the world, the Maison accompanies the precious moments of fulfilled men and women for whom watches and jewellery are talismans celebrating lasting Joie de Vivre. In harmony with this vision, Chopard acts through the prism of three fundamental elements: Craftsmanship, ensured by the work of passionate master artisans; abundant and generous Creativity; and Ethics. The Scheufele family, which has been guiding the Maison from generation to generation, believes that contemporary luxury must necessarily be responsible -- thus beginning its Journey to Sustainable Luxury in 2013. Today, Chopard uses 100% ethical gold for the production of its gold watches and jewellery, and manufactures its own Lucent Steel™ with a recycling rate of 80% for its steel timepieces.

name: CHOW TAI FOOK
description: Chow Tai Fook Jewellery is one of the world's largest pure-play jewellers, offering high-end luxury products including gem sets and gold products.

name: DIOR B2-52
description: At Maison Christian Dior, the love of perfume becomes a full-fledged lifestyle and opens the door to colouring every moment of your life.

name: CHRISTIAN LOUBOUTIN
description: Christian Louboutin established his business in the heart of Paris in 1991. His designs combine wit, glamour, and elegance all with his signature red lacquered sole. As an artist and craftsman with a true passion for shoes, his designs are unique, instantly recognisable and celebrated worldwide. The boutique concept is inspired by Christian's holiday house, and the store is designed to reflect a space where guests feel like they are in the home of a friend. The Christian Louboutin boutique offers a complete collection of Women's and Men's shoes, bags, accessories, fragrances, and makeup.

name: CLARINS
description: Clarins is a trusted family-owned French company founded in 1954. Born in a beauty institute and based on plant science, Clarins has become a recognized leader in skincare and make-up. Driven by innovation and respect for nature, Clarins is committed to promoting responsible beauty.

name: CLARINS SKIN SPA
description: Clarins was born at a spa in 1954 by Jacques Courtin Clarins. This unique expertise combines plant extract-enriched formulas with the highly effective manual techniques of Clarins Beauty Therapists. Today, Clarins is a recognized leader in skincare and body care, boasting over 65 years of expertise.

name: CLARKS
description: SHOEMAKERS SINCE 1825. Clarks story began almost 200 years ago when Cyrus and James Clark made a slipper from sheepskin off-cuts. At the time it was ground-breaking; a combination of invention and craftsmanship that's remained at the heart of what we do. And whilst now, as always, every pair of Clarks's shoes begins with a last carved by hand from a single block of hornbeam, advanced construction techniques, technologies and contemporary materials help us deliver perfection tailor-made for the modern world.

name: CLE DE PEAU BEAUTE
description: Founded in Japan in 1982 with the mission to forge new frontiers in advanced skin cell science, Clé de Peau Beauté products are created to empower skin to reach a desired state of harmony, embodying radiance and optimal qualities of texture, tone and contour. With a full range of exceptionally crafted skincare and makeup, Clé de Peau Beauté empowers each and every woman to unlock the power of radiance.

name: CLUB MONACO
description: CLUB MONACO was founded in 1985 around the idea of "elevated essentials". What began as a love of fabric has evolved into a lifestyle brand focused on considered details, unparalleled fit and intentional design. Each season brings the perfect wardrobe, filled with effortless, timeless essentials---classics with a French twist. Welcome to the Club.

name: COS
description: Inspired by contemporary culture, the London-based fashion brand is known for iconic wardrobe pieces, elevated essentials, and innovative designs that are made to last. Dedicated to quality and sustainability, COS takes a bespoke approach to design, creating unique collections that combine function with timeless style.

name: COTTON ON BODY
description: Cotton On Body empowers women to live the life they want, to show up for themselves and each other, every single day. Inspiring them to move their body, take time for self-care, and embrace their authenticity. Designed for women, by women, our global fashion-led range includes activewear, intimates, sleepwear, loungewear and swimwear.

name: COULISSE HEIR
description: Coulisse Heir is a place that represents the individual's transcendence towards self-love. An avant-garde service that aims to disrupt the idea of modern luxury services. It is a place where people discover new-found beauty, where they can be individualistic and expressive. People enjoy a powerful mix of art and comfort as they step into Coulisse Heir to pamper themselves physically and mentally.

name: CROCS
description: A world leader in innovative casual footwear for men, women and children. Crocs offers several distinct shoe collections with more than 300 footwear styles, from the iconic clog to new sneakers, sandals, boots and heels. All Crocs™ shoes feature Croslite™ material, a proprietary, revolutionary technology that gives each pair of shoes the soft, comfortable, lightweight and odor-resistant qualities that Crocs fans know and love. Since its inception in 2002, Crocs has sold more than 200 million pairs of shoes in more than 90 countries around the world.

name: CRUMPLER
description: Bags crafted with purpose, style, and functionality that are made with clever and innovative features. Built for purpose \& made to last.

name: CURIOUS CREATURES
description: Curious Creatures is a Singapore jewelry brand that designs demi-fine and fine jewelry for everyday and every occasion. Discover modern classics and one-of-a-kind jewelry pieces, experience the viral permanent jewelry trend and luxury piercing services, all under one roof.

name: DAISO
description: DAISO, established in Japan in 1977, is Japan's No.1 living ware supplier, with over 4,000 stores across the country and more than 2,200 stores in 28 nations worldwide. With over 70,000 different products in inventory, and more than 1,000 new products developed every month, the brand provides the most variety and value for all customer's needs. Daiso is committed to constantly produce quality products at affordable prices to enhance the lifestyles of our customers.

name: DESIGUAL
description: Desigual, an international fashion brand established in Barcelona, Spain in 1984. It's famous for the individuality and unique character of its creations, which aim to bring positivity and authenticity to thousands of people who want to express the best version of themselves. Present in over 100 countries globally, and now proud to extend our imprint and grand open in the ION Orchard store, inaugurating its flagship art gallery concept for the first time in Singapore.

name: DIESEL
description: Diesel is an innovative international lifestyle company, founded by Renzo Rosso in 1978. Rooted in denim mastery and evolved into being a leader in premium fashion, Diesel is now a true alternative to the established luxury market. Since 2020, Diesel's collections are overseen by creative director Glenn Martens, including apparel, accessories and a wide range of lifestyle collaborations.

name: DIOR
description: Christian Dior was the designer of dreams. As soon as his House was founded in 1946, and consecrated by the revolution of the New Look, his visionary spirit never ceased to glorify women all over the world.

name: DIOR PRESTIGE LA SUITE
description: Dior Prestige La Suite offers a unique sensory experience for every guest, providing treatments following sophisticated protocols exclusive to Dior. The wide suite of services includes the Prestige Grand Facial Treatment, Brightening and Radiance-Activating Treatment, Age-Delay and Beautifying Treatment, the Dior Homme Treatment for men, and sculpting treatments for facial contours and around the eyes. The transformation is spectacular - serenity, self-confidence and a new wave of energy are the signatures of these exceptional treatments.

name: DIPTYQUE
description: Born in exuberant, ebullient Saint Germain, Paris, in 1961, Diptyque is a creator of singular perfumes for the self and the home, scented skincare products, desirable decorative objects... and olfactory stories that set the imagination free. Striking a balance between reverie and reality, Diptyque extends an invitation to this rich, evocative universe -- this interplay of fragrance, illustration and mesmerising graphism -- in which are distilled memories of places loved or dreamed of, of moments lived, of journeys shared.

name: ECCO
description: Danish comfort and style since 1963. ECCO is one of the world's leading shoe brands combining style and comfort. Our success is built on products with a great fit and top-quality leathers innovative technology at our own tanneries and shoes factories.

name: ELEMIS LONDON
description: Elemis is a skin wellness brand with an aromatherapist's soul, an artist's spirit \& a scientist's commitment to results. Harnessing the power of nature's finest actives, high performance delivery systems \& revolutionary technology to create skin-friendly formulations with clinically proven results.

name: ENVIE DE POIS
description: Esteemed as one of Asia's leading multi-brand fashion retail store, enVie de Pois offers a wide variety of established labels as well as upcoming fashion cult labels in a luxurious retail space, offering customers an enjoyable and personalised shopping experience.

name: ESCENTIALS
description: escentials is the omnichannel destination for luxury niche fragrances, makeup, home, bath and body brands. Indulge in luxury - both bold and understated redefining the sensory experience of shopping. Immerse yourself in our brand and you're guaranteed to find something you love. We are all things beautiful.

name: ESTÉE LAUDER (ESTEE LAUDER)
description: With a reputation for innovation, sophistication and superior quality. Estée Lauder is one of the world's leading beauty brands, producing prestige skin care, makeup and fragrances. Today, we have stayed true to the philosophy that inspired our founder, Estée Lauder: Every Woman Can Be Beautiful.

name: EVISU
description: EVISU was founded in Osaka Japan, captured the imagination of the detail-obsessed Japanese fashion crowed and spurred a revival of interest in vintage denim which spread around the world.

name: FENDI
description: The house of FENDI was established by Adele and Edoardo Fendi in Rome in 1925. Winning international acclaim, FENDI emerged as a brand renowned for its elegance, craftsmanship, innovation, and style. Today FENDI is synonymous with quality, tradition, experimentation and creativity.

name: FILA
description: Fila is a worldwide leader in the realm of sporting and lifestyle footwear and apparel. Reverently embracing its esteemed Italian design heritage, the brand consistently endeavours to transcend the frontiers of contemporary performance wear.

name: FLOWER MATTERS
description: Flower Matters is born out of passion for flowers and has since expanded our collections with brands like Jellycats, Rifle Paper, Lagom and Meri Meri.

name: FRANCK MULLER
description: Every part of a Franck Muller watch is produced in-house, from the tiniest screws to the case. Each component is machined in the factories, polished by hand and tested for performance before they are assembled by the watchmakers into a complete timepiece.

name: FRED PERRY
description: Fred Perry prides itself on being the first British heritage brand to successfully blend sportswear with streetwear to create some of the most iconic styles of the last century. Throughout our history we have always stayed true to our ethos of authenticity, integrity and attitude.

name: FRESH
description: Born in Boston and raised in New York, Fresh delivers sensorial beauty as effective as it is indulgent. By combining potent natural ingredients, ancient rituals, and modern science, Fresh creates products that perform with experiences that transform, including a range of skincare, fragrances and bodycare.

name: G-SHOCK CASIO
description: Casio G-Factory offers a wide range of high technology and digital watches - from G Shock, Baby-G, to Edifice, Sheen and Protrek.

name: GENTLE MONSTER
description: The Gentle Monster Singapore ION Orchard store foretells a futuristic story of the fragmentation and reinterpretation of data. The flood of discrete images from the digital space is reintegrated to express a new self through one's own 'Awakening.'

name: GIORGIO ARMANI BEAUTY
description: Giorgio Armani translates his sense of fashion and aesthetic vision into the world of fragrance, makeup, and skincare. Ever elegant, his creations embody beauty, simplicity, and quality delivered through the finest materials. Timeless fragrances have become the quintessence of Armani style for the modern man, while his lipsticks---a symbol of seduction---are adored by women around the world. Armani beauty begins with the ritual of radiant skin. Prep, perfect, and sculpt your complexion with Giorgio Armani makeup, including cult-favourites like Master Primer and Power Fabric Foundation. Finding your perfect skin match is as easy as following the Giorgio Armani dress code for face. Each foundation is inspired by the world's finest textiles and achieves a silken texture as enticing as the softest fabrics against the skin. Finish every look with an award-winning lip colour. Lips are the symbol of seduction, especially when drenched in cult-classics like Giorgio Armani Lip Maestro, a long

name: GOLDHEART JEWEL GALLERIA
description: A modern and innovative brand, Goldheart is a leading group of open-concept fine jewellery boutiques in Singapore that provides an unparalleled retail experience. With exclusive in-house designs that exude artistry and masterful craftsmanship, every boutique is a treasure trove of timeless gold, brilliant diamonds \& gems jewellery.

name: GRAF VON FABER-CASTELL
description: Graf von Faber-Castell is the premium brand of Faber-Castell, with the collection handmade in Germany. Being one of the world's leading manufacturers of quality products for writing, drawing with over 260 years of history, these stylish high-quality writing instruments come in premium wood and leather, intricately designed to meet your needs.

name: GRAFF
description: Home to the most fabulous jewels in the world, GRAFF represents the pinnacle of luxury and rarity with exceptional quality diamonds and gemstones adorned with impeccable designs and unrivalled craftsmanship. Step inside GRAFF and discover the brilliance of natural wonders, from signature collections to exquisite Engagement and Bridal jewels.

name: GUARDIAN B4
description: Guardian Health \& Beauty is the leading health and beauty chain in Singapore since 1972. Guardian has evolved from its pharmacy roots into a holistic one-stop solution for customers' health and beauty needs. It continues to expand its product and service range to meet the redefinition of beauty by today's customers -- where health meets beauty.

name: GUCCI
description: Founded in Florence, Italy, in 1921, Gucci is one of the world's leading luxury brands. Under the leadership of President and CEO Francesca Bellettini and the artistic direction of Demna, the House continues to redefine luxury and fashion while celebrating creativity, Italian craftsmanship, and innovation. Gucci is part of the global luxury group Kering, which manages renowned Houses in fashion, leather goods, jewelry, eyewear, and beauty.

name: GUCCI BEAUTY
description: Discover Gucci Beauty's first flagship boutique in Singapore. The boutique offers Gucci Beauty makeup alongside the House's women's and men's fragrance collections. Offering an omnichannel customer experience, the boutique also integrates touchpoints such as interactive tables and screens with educational product content where clients can immerse themselves in the world of Gucci fragrances.

name: GUERLAIN
description: Since 1828, Guerlain has explored, innovated and elevated beauty in Fragrances, Skincare and Makeup. Guerlain's bold creative talents have crafted mythic creations, drawing on timeless savoir-faire. Nature and Art are our inspirations and the Culture of Beauty is our signature.

name: HAIR ATELIER BY SHUNJI MATSUO
description: Shunji Matsuo salons present the latest Japanese-influenced international hair styling, perming and coloring techniques, to deliver beautiful, versatile hairstyles that match the personality and lifestyle needs of each customer. Designer hair services prices available upon request.

name: HARRY WINSTON
description: Founded in New York City in 1932, Harry Winston continues to set the standard for the ultimate in fine jewelry and luxury watchmaking. Known throughout his life as the "King of Diamonds" and "Jeweler to the Stars," Mr. Winston's innovative philosophy---in which the gemstones, rather than metal dictate the design---helped to revolutionize modern-day fine jewelry, and remains at the cornerstone of a timeless aesthetic that inspires all Winston designs today.

name: HELENA RUBINSTEIN
description: Inspired by the spirit of avant-garde of its founder, Helena Rubinstein's commitment to innovation is driven by science, with the same objective at it was in 1902 : to empower women through beauty. Premium skincare brand of avant-garde, it offers women the power of youth with the most cutting-edge and highly concentrated products, for visible efficacy. The ultimate combination of a strong brand heritage and advanced scientific expertise. Known for its scientific expertise, unmatched formulas, and iconic products, Helena Rubinstein will redefine the frontier of luxury skincare in Singapore.

name: HOKA
description: HOKA® is one of the fastest-growing performance footwear and apparel brands in history. Conceived in the mountains, HOKA footwear delivers an unprecedented combination of enhanced cushioning and support for a uniquely smooth ride. Every day, HOKA pushes the innovation and design of its footwear and apparel by teaming up with a deep roster of world champions, taste makers and everyday athletes. From finish lines to everyday life, HOKA fans love the brand for its bold and unexpected approach, and its belief in the power of humanity to create change for a better world. HOKA empowers a world of athletes to fly over the earth.

name: HUBLOT
description: Founded in 1980, Hublot's ground-breaking, high-quality approach to watchmaking has led to innovative designs and high levels of craftsmanship, both in terms of materials and its manufacture movements.

name: HUGO
description: The HUGO collection is created for the rule-breakers who go their own way, offering contemporary pieces like denim, jersey, dresses, and outerwear, with individuality and attitude. #HUGOYourWay

name: I-PRIMO
description: I-PRIMO, a renowned bridal ring store from Japan, offers over 200 designs of rings inspired by the myths and constellations with each carrying heartfelt meanings of fortune and love to the couple for the rest of their lives.

name: IN GOOD COMPANY
description: Characteristically modern and quietly confident, IN GOOD COMPANY creates modular wardrobe essentials for women and men.

name: IWC SCHAFFHAUSEN
description: Over its 150 year history, IWC Schaffhausen has developed a reputation for creating functional complications, especially chronographs and calendars, which are ingenious, robust, and easy for customers to use. A pioneer in the use of titanium and ceramics, IWC today specialises in highly engineered technical watch cases manufactured from advanced materials, such as titaniumaluminide and Ceratanium®. Preferring the principle of "form follows function" over decoration, the Swiss watch manufacturer's timeless creations embody their owners' dreams and ambitions as they journey through life.

name: JD SPORTS
description: JD Sports is the leading sneaker and sport fashion retailer. With many limited edition and exclusive designs from Adidas, Nike, New Balance, Supply \& Demand and many more.

name: JENNIFER GREEN
description: Jennifer Green Jewellery prides itself on designing one-of-a-kind pieces that offer a contemporary interpretation of traditional Asian jewellery. Designs range from the understated elegance of simple classic style drop earrings to show-stopping statement pieces. Explore the collection of Type A jadeites and mix gems set in 14K and 18K gold at Jennifer Green.

name: JERIC SALON
description: Established by hairstyling icon Jeric See, Jeric Salon uses the latest cutting-edge techniques in today's fashion.

name: JO MALONE LONDON
description: Understated style. Defined by a rather unconventional sense of sophistication. Jo Malone London is a British fragrance and lifestyle brand, with a contemporary point of view. Timeless and elegant but always infused with a charming dash of wit and whimsy. From the start, their colognes have been revolutionary in their elegant simplicity and pioneering in their use of ingredients. Jo Malone London has evolved to become synonymous with coveted scents and luxurious products for bath, body, and home.

name: JUNGSAEMMOOL
description: JUNGSAEMMOOL Beauty is a professional makeup artist brand constantly pursuing the goal of 'Natural Beauty' from within.

name: KALEIDO
description: At Kaleido, they offer a vast and eclectic collection designed to inspire individuals to explore various facets of their personal style. From minimalistic pieces for the understated to bold creations for the adventurous, the brand's collection serves as a canvas for you to paint a portrait of your evolving self. Join them on a journey of discovery, using jewelry as a means to explore facets of you.

name: KATE SPADE
description: Kate Spade New York has always stood for colour, wit, optimism, and femininity. Today, it is a global lifestyle brand synonymous with joy, delivering seasonal collections of handbags, ready-to-wear, jewellery, footwear, gifts, home décor and more.

name: KERASTASE
description: Kérastase care-first philosophy since 1964 has been strongly empowering women through the best professional luxury haircare. The first Kérastase concept store in Singapore offers bespoke products and treatments to enhance all types of hair. Explore the Kérastase world that ultimately combines cutting-edge technology and beauty.

name: KIEHL'S SINCE 1851
description: Since 1851, Kiehl's remained dedicated to providing uniquely efficacious skin, hair and bodycare products. The nature-inspired, scientifically-proven formulas are powerful yet safe and help improve skin quality for visibly healthier-looking skin. Experience Kiehl's personalized consultation today.

name: KIPLING
description: Est. 1987 in Antwerp, Belgium, Kipling crafts lightweight, sustainable handbags and accessories, embodying a carefree spirit. Renowned for signature crinkled nylon and iconic monkey keychain, Kipling delivers practical, durable accessories globally, promoting a "Live Light" lifestyle.

name: KLARRA
description: Our mission is to provide value and inspiration to our community for an inspired, everyday living through creations with great attention to detail and quality, designed to be used and loved for a long time. We strive to grow alongside our community, putting you at the forefront and creating thoughtful, meaningful experiences and relationships with you. We wish to give everyone the freedom of expression through KLARRA, so we craft our aesthetics and products to accompany you in your everyday and through your different phases of life.

name: LA MER
description: La Mer began after Dr. Max Huber harnessed the healing powers of the sea: The Miracle Broth™ was birthed forth -- found in the heart of every La Mer product. Immerse into the world of La Mer at ION Orchard with our Experts, or experience a pampering session at the Spa de la Mer!

name: LA PRAIRIE
description: La Prairie was born on the shores of Lac Leman where a pioneering doctor discovered the key to timeless beauty. Made from natural riches sought deep in the ocean, precious minerals from the Earth's core, flora indigenous only to the mountains of Switzerland and the latest technological processes, La Prairie is forever on the forefront of advanced science. The brand has become a symbol of excellence, a name inextricably linked with timelessness. Made from natural riches sought deep in the ocean, precious minerals from the Earth's core, flora indigenous only to the mountains of Switzerland and the latest technological processes, La Prairie is forever on the forefront of advanced science.

name: LAC
description: LAC, a subsidiary of V3 Brands, is a leading health and wellness supplement brand with a global presence. Since its founding, LAC, short for Leader in Antioxidative Control, has embarked on a pioneering journey to develop scientifically based formulas, harnessing the best of eastern wisdom and western technology to fight free radicals, combat ageing brought forth by oxidative stress, and support you daily in looking, feeling, and functioning at your best.

name: LACOSTE
description: Founded by French tennis legend René Lacoste, four-time international champion and the world's best player in 1926-1927, the Lacoste brand draws inspiration from sporting values of high standards, fair play and daring. It passes down these values through the generations and cultivates elegance as a way of being and inventing one's life.

name: LEE HWA DIAMOND PROMENADE
description: Designing jewellery for the most heartfelt and precious moments in life -- keepsakes to love, wear and treasure forever. A romantic proposal, a dream wedding, a delightful baby shower, a birthday surprise, a meaningful anniversary or a well-deserved promotion -- Lee Hwa Jewellery helps you immortalise those memories with gems that are perfect for the occasion.

name: LEGO
description: Bricks World is the oldest and largest specialist LEGO retailer in Singapore. Bricks World aims to deliver the LEGO experience through the breadth of its product offering, monthly deals, and excellent customer service.

name: LEICA
description: Leica Camera AG is an international, premium manufacturer of cameras and sports optics. For 100 years now, famous photographers from around the world have been capturing once-in-a-lifetime moments with their Leica camera. The legendary reputation of the Leica brand is founded on a long tradition of excellence in the construction of lenses and optical devices with German craftsmanship and industrial design, combined with cutting-edge technology. Today, the high-performance, outstanding precision and exceptional quality of Leica cameras and lenses continue to exercise their unique fascination and stand for the enduring values of 'Made in Germany'.

name: LEVI'S
description: The Levi's® brand epitomizes classic American style and effortless cool. Since their invention in 1873, Levi's® jeans have become one of the most recognizable garments of clothing in the world---capturing the imagination and loyalty of people for generations.

name: L'OCCITANE
description: L'OCCITANE is loved worldwide for its extensive range of skincare, hair care, body care, and hand care. Inspired by and made with the ingredients of Provence, L'OCCITANE's products are formulated by experts and produced exclusively in France at its eco-certified factory and laboratories in Manosque.

name: LOEWE
description: Created in 1846, LOEWE approaches 175 years as one of the world's major luxury houses. Under the creative direction of Jonathan Anderson, the brand has started a new chapter, presenting itself to the world as a house focused on craft and culture, and an unmatched expertise with leather.

name: LONGCHAMP
description: Founded in Paris in 1948, Longchamp is an international brand whose creativity and vitality have remained strong for many decades. It embodies Paris chic and the uninhibited, slightly rebellious nature of the French art of living.

name: LORO PIANA
description: Uncompromising quality, the finest fibers, production entirely based in Italy and 200 years of textile expertise and excellence are the pillars on which Loro Piana has built its reputation as a leader in the luxury goods sector. In Loro Piana's Italian mills, Cashmere, Baby Cashmere, Vicuña and the finest Merino wools are transformed into a range of garments and accessories that combine painstaking attention to detail with state of the art technology and performance, ideal for refined, active lifestyles.

name: LOUIS VUITTON
description: Since 1854, Louis Vuitton remains faithful to the spirit of its founder, Louis Vuitton, who introduced the "Art of Travel", and continues to combine innovation and craftsmanship at the highest level through its offerings of Leather Goods, Ready-to-Wear, Shoes, Accessories, Watches, Jewellery and Fragrance.

name: LOVE, BONITO
description: Love, Bonito makes infinitely wearable clothes; timelessly feminine pieces for all of life's in-betweens. Designed for all the real, everyday stuff that no one else gets. Lovingly made for Asian women. Crafted with the thoughtfulness every woman deserves. Ready-to-live, not just ready-to-wear.

name: LOVE & CO.
description: Love \& Co. celebrates the proclamation of romance with an exceptional range of couple bands and engagement rings. The bespoke designs are infused with the finest craftsmanship and creativity that will certainly find favour amongst the discerning couples who are in search of the promise of eternal love. Love \& Co. also celebrates individual stories through customisation that extends into gifting jewellery -- a fun and attainable segment for you to express your personality. Love \& Co redefines traditions to offer jewellery that can be made truly yours in many ways, as well as, diamonds crafted for our increasingly conscious world.

name: LOVET
description: Founded and designed in Singapore, Lovet's thoughtfully crafted apparel designs stem from fine quality and comfort. From minimalistic staples to elevated looks, we are committed to perfecting the fit for everyday people in creating their own stories through different stages in life.

name: LOVISA
description: Lovisa was born from a desire to fill the void for high quality, fashion-forward and directional pieces that are brilliantly affordable.

name: LULUCRYSTALSX
description: Discover crystal jewellery that speaks to your soul, and supports your intentions --- only at Lulucrystalsx. Proudly recognized as Singapore's top choice for exquisite crystal accessories, Lulucrystalsx pieces are crafted using 100% natural crystals. Every bracelet is thoughtfully designed and meticulously handcrafted in-house, right here in Singapore. Lulucrystalsx exclusive designs blend elegance with intention, making each piece not only beautiful but truly one-of-a-kind.

name: LULULEMON
description: lululemon is a healthy lifestyle inspired athletic apparel company for yoga, running, training, and most other sweaty pursuits, creating transformational products and experiences which enable people to live a life they love. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional designs, lululemon works with yogis and athletes in local communities for continuous research and product feedback.

name: LUSH
description: Lush concept store features a palette of pine and white tiles with neutral tones contrasting the vibrant colours of the product range. It's table tops and sundries are also beautifully crafted from 100% recycled and sustainable panels by Smile Plastics. Layers of colours fill the store to create an immersive experience.

name: MAJE
description: Judith Milgrom, Founder and Artistic Director created Maje; a brand that embodies generosity, creativity, femininity, and liberty. The brand is also, above all, a story of her family. Maje was born in Paris in 1998, and has since become an international brand, drawing inspiration from global influences, now present in 44 countries with 627 points of sale. The cult favourite French brand has developed ready-to-wear and accessories collections over the years and established itself as a leader for accessible luxury. The brand has always offered bold, urban \& modern pieces for all women and all occasions. Maje embodies a feminine silhouette that is understated yet glamorous, featuring both trend-led and classic pieces with subtle details and twist.

name: MANGO
description: Mango features a diverse collection of trendy apparel for the modern contemporary woman.

name: MARIMEKKO
description: Marimekko is a Finnish lifestyle design company renowned for its original prints and colors. It's product portfolio comprises high-quality clothing, bags and accessories as well as home décor items ranging from textiles to tableware.

name: MASSIMO DUTTI
description: Massimo Dutti epitomizes a rarefied vision of natural elegance in today's world. The brand creates sophisticated fashion to serve urbane and independent people who understand that quality of style is the true reflection of quality life.

name: MASTER-FIX SERVICES
description: Master Fix Services specialises in the following services: key duplicating, shoe repairs, recolouring services, stretching services and bag repairs.

name: MAX&CO.
description: Dynamic and smart, MAX\&Co. is dedicated to fashion-conscious women who are eager to project a nonchalant style that transcends the dominant seasonal codes. With its roots in the Italian sartorial tradition blending with creative and technological experimentations on forms, materials and colors, MAX\&Co. creates effortless fashion which serves as versatile mosaic pieces to your wardrobe. Always on the forefront of fashion that is chic and fun, MAX\&Co. inspires an unexpected, innovative approach to contemporary dressing.

name: MIZU AESTHETIC CLINIC + AERAS
description: Mizu Aesthetic Clinic is a one-stop destination for premier medical aesthetic treatments delivered with artful skill. Founded and led by Dr Tan Ying Zhou, Mizu offers non-surgical anti-ageing, skin rejuvenation, face augmentation and body sculpting treatments aimed at helping people look like themselves, but better.

name: MLB
description: Acquired the official license of Major League Baseball, the first MLB KOREA store opened in 1997. Today, they are operating 280 stores in Korea, and also rolling out overseas business in Asia. MLB KOREA is the first business model who launch MLB as a lifestyle fashion brand. They offer a comprehensive collection of apparel and accessories for men, women, and kids. Their product is a combination of utility and fashion.

name: MONICA VINADER
description: At Monica Vinader, it is all about luxury jewellery at accessible prices. Crafting iconic designs for everyday wear - not just special occasions - with recycled gold and silver, ethical diamonds and natural gemstones. Immerse yourself in the world of MV in ION Orchard Boutique - complimentary engraving and monogramming stations.

name: MONTIGO
description: At Montigo, hydration comes first. Montigo creates innovative, customisable drinkware that fuels enjoyment in every pursuit. From morning coffee to evening refreshment, Montigo products seamlessly blend into your daily rhythm, adding a touch of personal flair.

name: MUJI
description: Founded in Japan in 1980, MUJI, short for "Mujirushi Ryohin" or "no brand quality goods," offers high-quality, functional, affordable products. Minimalist designs cater to modern urban living in clothing, stationery, and household items.

name: NAILZ TREATS
description: Nailz Treats is a full-fledged nail salon providing you a non-toxic beauty experience with a strong emphasis on clean environment and clean beauty for the community by carefully selecting and using only non-toxic, vegan gel and lacquer and offering products and services that are paraben-free and cruelty-free

name: NATURELAND SPA. PREMIUM
description: Experience the perfect spa indulgence at Natureland. An essential escape from urban demands of a hectic life, the plethora of therapeutic body and foot massages are carefully curated to balance one's mind, body and soul. Nestled in the heart of Orchard, Natureland ION Orchard offers a serene and luxurious retreat for a soulful and rejuvenating experience.

name: NB 1906
description: From its humble beginnings in 1906, New Balance has stood for heritage and quality. What started as a small athletics company in Boston, Massachusetts, is now a global pioneer and one of the largest sportswear brands in the industry.

name: NESPRESSO
description: Immerse yourself in a multi-sensory coffee experience at our ION Orchard boutique. Experience the elements that reflect Nespresso's deep commitment to high quality coffee and sustainability. Visit us to discover high-quality, sustainably-produced coffee, all with a touch of a button.

name: OMEGA
description: For more than 160 years, Swiss luxury brand OMEGA has stayed true to its pioneering spirit of technical precision and excellence. Its timepieces are works of art that continue to make watchmaking history with innovation in areas as far as space and the depths of the ocean.

name: OPERA GALLERY
description: Founded by Gilles Dyan in 1994 and established with galleries worldwide, Opera Gallery is one of the leading dealers in Modern and Contemporary European, American and Asian art with 16 galleries around the world. Opera Gallery Singapore presents high-calibre art through intricately curated exhibitions of works from Contemporary and Modern masters.

name: OPTICAL 88 PREMIER
description: OPTICAL 88 is the premier eye care specialist in the region, providing technologically advanced solutions and lifestyle products. We see your eyes as the key to your soul and entrance to the world. With a mission to preserve the best moment in your life, we strive to guard your vision health.

name: OWNDAYS
description: Leading Japanese eyewear brand OWNDAYS is committed to offering high-quality, fashionable eyewear at affordable prices. With a vast selection of over 1,500 stylish options starting from $98, your glasses can be ready for you in just 20 minutes upon payment.

name: PANDORA
description: Delicately hand crafted to the finest quality, PANDORA provides the perfect adornment for every mood and occasion. From necklace statement pieces to the subtle sparkle of delicate bracelets, walk into every room with understated beauty.

name: PANERAI
description: Founded in Florence in 1860 as a workshop, shop and subsequently school of watch-making, for many decades Panerai supplied the Italian Navy and its specialist diving corps in particular with precision instruments. The designs developed by Panerai in that time, including the Luminor and Radiomir, were covered by the Military Secrets Act for many years and were launched on the international market only after the brand was acquired by the Richemont Group in 1997. Today Panerai develops and crafts its movements and watches at its Neuchâtel manufacture. The latter is a seamless melding of Italian design flair and history with Swiss horological expertise. Panerai watches are sold across the world through an exclusive network of distributors and Panerai boutiques.

name: PARFUMS CHRISTIAN DIOR
description: Discover Dior Beauty's flagship boutique located at B2-53. Beyond iconic Dior parfums, makeup \& skincare products, discover the boutique's curated selection of fashion jewelry.

name: PATEK PHILIPPE
description: As an independent watchmaker since 1839, Patek Philippe enjoys the creative freedom to design and produce some of the finest watches in the world. Patek Philippe incorporates innovation and centuries-old watchmaking expertise to create timepieces that are proudly passed down from one generation to the next. Tapping into their extraordinary experience, the Swiss company has an impressive portfolio comprising over 100 patents. The Patek Philippe Boutique by Cortina Watch invites guests into the universe of exceptional watchmaking, with its spatial design and elegantly appointed interiors that have been curated and crafted with exceeding attention to detail. Embark on your personal horological journey with the knowledgeable team of watch specialists at the Patek Philippe Boutique by Cortina Watch.

name: PEDRO
description: At PEDRO, we create effortless fashion essentials to empower confidence in individuality. By relating, refining and reinventing, we create updated essentials that blends seamlessly into different wardrobes of style.

name: PIAGET
description: Piaget is a renowned Swiss watchmaker and jeweller known for crafting exquisite timepieces and jewellery since 1874. It's commitment to excellence is reflected in their "Ateliers de l'Extraordinaire," where master artisans harness rare skills, transforming gold, stones, and precious gems into dazzling pieces of art. Piaget's legacy is built on innovation, evident in their ultra-thin watch movements, which became the Maison's trademark. From the intricate details of their watches to the elegant designs of their jewellery, Piaget embodies mastery and flamboyance. Whether you seek sophisticated or elegant design, Piaget offers a wide range of creations that truly express it.

name: PICOTA NAIL SPA
description: In need of a pampering session for your hands and feet? Picota Nail Spa offers a wide range of manicure and pedicure services and treatments.

name: POP MART
description: Founded in 2010, POP MART is the largest and fastest-growing pop-toy maker in China. Check out exciting selection of licensed pop-toys with new designs released every week, from brands such as Disney, Warner Bros, Universal Pictures to characters like Molly, Dimoo, The Monsters, SKULLPANDA and more!

name: PRADA
description: Since 1913, Prada has established itself as a forerunner in fashion with its display of elegantly crafted bags, trunks and leather accessories.

name: PRESTO DRYCLEANERS
description: With over 25 years of dry cleaning and laundry experience, we care for your garments with professionalism, reliability, high quality, and convenience. At Presto Drycleaners, we make sure that every piece of garment, curtain, bedding and carpet are all clean and fresh! Our laundry and drycleaning services provide ease and convenience with a quick turnaround so you'll get your items cleaned, fresh and packed neatly.

name: PROOF LIVING
description: Proof Living is your hub for designer furniture in Singapore. Here at Proof Living, we carry coveted designer furniture powerhouses such as Poltrona Frau, Ceccotti Collezioni, Paola Lenti and Occhio among various others. Discover a modern, sleek, and stylish world of home furnishing with us.

name: PULSE+ALLIED HEALTH CLINIC / PULSE TCM CLINIC
description: PULSE TCM was first established with the goal to harmonise a modern outlook with traditional TCM knowledge and techniques. All physicians are registered under TCMPB (Traditional Chinese Medicine Practitioners Board), a statutory board under the Ministry of Health.

name: RAY-BAN
description: Courage, Authenticity, and Timeless style are the core values of Ray-Ban, a leader in prescription and sun eyewear for generations since its establishment in 1937. From the introduction of the iconic Aviator model created for US military pilots, Ray-Ban has been at the forefront of cultural change, becoming a symbol of self-expression.

name: RED ARMY WATCHES
description: Since 2004, Red Army Watches (RAW) has brought to you unique, independent, mechanical watch brands to ignite your horological passions. Step into RAW to experience watches from Alexander Shorokhoff, Aviator, Azimuth, Baltic, Delma, Gorilla, Mido, Oris, Reservoir, SEVENFRIDAY, Sturmanskie, and more.

name: RISIS
description: RISIS started its roots in Singapore since 1976 and was renowned as the brand which encapsulated Natural Orchids in Gold. Since then, RISIS has been producing collections of Jewellery, Home and Lifestyle that are encapsulated in 24K Swiss Gold and other precious metals, singing to the different facets of its unique identity. All of RISIS' products are fully handcrafted, showcasing the nature of its artistry through fine craftsmanship. The collections are based on Nature-inspired and Asian Heritage themes that strongly reflect the brand's core identity.

name: RITUALS
description: Rituals is Europe's iconic Body, Home, and Gifting brand dedicated to sustainability and personal wellbeing. Rituals believes that happiness can be found in the smallest of things. As a foremost founder of integrating bath, body and home care into a single portfolio, Rituals embraces the lifestyle of transforming everyday routines into more meaningful moments. Each product is inspired by an ancient tradition. With an extensive collection of luxurious yet affordable home and body cosmetics using unique signature fragrances that are carefully designed and composed by the world's finest perfumers, Rituals invites the consumer to enrich their world with wellbeing moments. As part of Rituals' commitment to continuously improve its social \& environmental impact, the brand is focused on 90% natural origin formulas and packaging that's either refillable, recyclable or made of recycled material. Founded in Amsterdam in 2000, Rituals has since been established as a global industr

name: ROLEX
description: The Hour Glass is proud to be part of the worldwide network of Official Rolex Retailers, allowed to sell and maintain Rolex watches. Discover the world of Rolex and let our professional team of watch specialists share our passion and knowledge with you today.

name: ROYAL SELANGOR
description: Founded in 1885, Royal Selangor is the world's foremost name in quality pewter. From tableware, drinkware, wine \& bar to personal accessories, each piece combines a tradition of craftsmanship and modern techniques. Royal Selangor counts premier champagne houses Dom Pérignon, Krug, Veuve Clicquot, and major global brands, amongst its clients for bespoke commissions, and its collections include works by internationally renowned designers.

name: SAINT LAURENT
description: Founded in 1961, Yves Saint Laurent is a prominent 20th-century fashion house that initially focused on Haute Couture. In 1966, Yves Saint Laurent revolutionized fashion by introducing high-end ready-to-wear clothing on a larger scale. The brand, led by couturier Yves Saint Laurent, holds significant influence both within and beyond the fashion world. Recognised for its distinctive identity and strong codes, the Maison is known for its revolutionary spirit ingrained in its DNA. In 2016, Creative Director Anthony Vaccarello took the helm, infusing the brand with a highly desirable vision that pays tribute to Paris, the atelier, and savoir-faire. His collections reflect a modern perspective, affirming a 360-degree vision for Saint Laurent and propelling the brand into the future with clarity and determination.

name: SAMSONITE
description: With over 110 years of heritage, Samsonite has built an extensive legacy in trendsetting travel solutions. Recognizing the brand's nfluence and leveraging its expertise in innovation, Samsonite is now setting out our vision to become the most sustainable lifestyle bag and travel luggage company in the world.

name: SANDRO
description: Known for its clean lines and sophisticated aesthetic, Sandro is a leading agile luxury Parisian brand featuring refined and versatile men's and women's collections. Evelyne Chetrite, founder and creative director since 1984, developed a new women's aesthetic: modern and sophisticated with a hint of androgyny. In line with the Sandro sensibility, Evelyne's son, Ilan, launched Sandro Homme in 2008 focusing on revisited classics with a modern twist. Today, Sandro has over 730 points of sales worldwide.

name: SEPHORA
description: Sephora, where beauty beats. Discover the best in makeup, skin care, and more from a wide selection of beauty brands.

name: SHISEIDO
description: Born in Ginza, Made for the World. For more than 150 years, SHISEIDO has thoughtfully fused Eastern and Western philosophies and innovations together to serve as a beacon of beauty inspiration---especially the Japanese sense of spiritual beauty---for everyone all over the globe.

name: SHU UEMURA
description: Play, master, create your own beauty -- enter the Tokyo makeup atelier and discover cutting-edge makeup artistry with top-quality Japanese excellence in colors and services. From Tokyo to the world, shu uemura delivers the expertise of Asian beauty through the art of makeup, infused with the DNA of the legendary Japanese makeup artist, Mr. shu uemura. Discover unique products and tools made with a frontier spirit of innovation, micro-detailed Japanese craftsmanship and a dazzling spectrum of colors.

name: SINGAPORE AIRLINES
description: Enjoy enhanced convenience and a seamless service experience at the Singapore Airlines Service Centre.

name: SINGAPORE POST
description: For more than 160 years, Singapore Post has been delivering trusted and reliable services to homes and businesses in Singapore as the country's postal service provider. Offerings include a wide range of products and services such as stamp purchases, sending and collection of letters and parcels, bill payments, financial services and more.

name: SINGTEL
description: Singtel Exclusive Retailer provides an extensive selection of Singtel services, encompassing mobile and fixed broadband as well as prepaid and postpaid options. Customers can enjoy a diverse array of choices, from the latest mobile phones to lifestyle-related accessories and gadgets, catering to all their communication and lifestyle needs.

name: SK JEWELLERY
description: Unwrap Joy at SK Jewellery! Your ultimate destination for all your gifting needs. From Disney magic to timeless pearls, dazzling gold, and wedding wonders, our wide collection is perfect for every celebration. Dive into our dazzling collection -- visit our stores for an exclusive, shimmering experience.

name: SMIGGLE
description: Smiggle is the ultimate destination for your school, birthday and leisure essentials. From backpacks and drink bottles, to gift packs and keyrings, Smiggle is the original creator of all things colourful, fun, unique and on trend.

name: SPA ELEMENTS
description: Spa Elements is where you relax while effectively rejuvenate, ensuring that your time is well spent with us. With more than 22 years of history, our highly experienced team delivers quality massages and facial treatments that cater to your individual preferences. Whether you are looking to relax and recharge, or seeking specific solutions like pain management and anti-aging facial care, our team is poised to meet your needs. We focus on wellness that is effective.

name: STEINWAY & SONS
description: Much more than a state-of-the-art retail and performance space, the STEINWAY GALLERY at ION Orchard -- the "centre of gravity" in the retail scene, houses a selection of grand and upright pianos from Steinway \& Sons including its latest innovation -- the Steinway SPIRIO, a high resolution re-performance piano, to exquisite pianos from the Steinway Crown Jewel Collection. Completing the Steinway Family of Pianos are the Boston and Essex, pianos that are designed by Steinway \& Sons. The Gallery's façade is façade is uniquely designed to resemble the shape of the brand's lyra and its curvature, with a Steinway Grand displayed elegantly at the storefront.

name: STELLAR
description: Stellar provides the most comprehensive ear-piercing service in Singapore that reinforces your confidence and elegance with a new sparkling jewellery. Widely known as the No.1 Ear Piercing in Singapore, specialising in ear piercing for all ages especially kids as young as 2 months old.

name: STRIP & BROWHAUS
description: Choose from a wide range of professional hair removal, body shaping treatments, brow, lash, and beauty services.

name: STRYV
description: Stryv is a proudly Singaporean brand dedicated to making top-tier hair styling and grooming accessible to all. Founded with the belief that self-care empowers confidence, stryv partners with industry-leading manufacturers and hair professionals to deliver salon-grade tools and products, without the hefty price tag. From innovative wireless stylers to powerful, lightweight hairdryers, every Stryv product undergoes rigorous quality testing to ensure performance and durability. With a commitment to affordability, premium quality, and customer satisfaction---including up to 2 years warranty and customer support---Stryv has quickly become a local favourite, now with multiple outlets across Singapore. Discover a better you through enjoyable routines: "Find your way to a better you with a routine you enjoy. Stryv with us, one ritual at a time."

name: SULWHASOO
description: Sulwhasoo, the global iconic luxury beauty brand, was the first to carefully craft products infused with ginseng, one of Asia's most precious herbs well-known for its many efficacies. Powered by heritage \& unique skin science, Sulwhasoo creates products as works of art that transcend time \& generations, inspiring people to create their own version of beauty.

name: SUNGLASS HUT
description: Founded in 1971 as a small kiosk in a Miami mall, today Sunglass Hut is the ultimate sunglasses destination with more than 3,000 retail locations worldwide, offering high-quality fashion and performance sunglass brands and inspiring authentic self-expression.

name: SUNNYSTEP
description: Sunnystep makes the best walking shoes, both ergonomic and stylish, designed to minimize stress on the feet and the bodies and cater to a dynamic lifestyle.

name: SUPERGA
description: It's hard to believe that Superga is well over 100 years old. Under the care and attention of Walter Martiny in 1911, the Superga factory began to produce shoes with vulcanized rubber soles. It was in Turin, Italy, the Classic Superga 2750 heritage style was born. The 2750 shoe has been an icon since the very beginning and has inspired flatforms and mid tops, been transformed for all weathers, and has collaborated with top names to bring you fresh new designs. Taking you from the city to the beach, from the office to the bar, the easy, comfortable Superga shoe has no boundaries.

name: SWATCH
description: Positive provocation and joie de vivre made in Switzerland: since its founding in 1983, Swatch has shaken up the watch industry. Thanks to its striking designs which always reflect the zeitgeist, Swatch is one of the leading watch manufacturers and the most sought-after brands in the world --- and has always stayed true to itself. The watchmaker continues to surprise, whether with regularly released new models or special collections. The revolutionary way in which Swatch thinks and acts has always been evident with its early involvement in action sports, such as BMX, skateboarding and surfing. The Swatch Art Peace Hotel in Shanghai embodies the brand's love of art and brings together artists from around the world.

name: TAG HEUER
description: TAG Heuer's Designed to Win campaign marks a bold new era, where innovation meets endurance and success is no longer just the outcome, but part of the design itself. For 165 years, TAG Heuer has demonstrated pure avant-garde watchmaking spirit and a commitment to innovation with revolutionary technologies. Discover TAG Heuer's iconic collections at ION Orchard.

name: TAKA JEWELLERY TREASURES
description: TAKA Jewellery's extensive range of jewellery items and designs consist of classic solitaires for everyday wear, to coloured gemstones and designer statement pieces for parties or functions. Most recently, the brand launched its 999 Gold collection at competitive prices, once again ascertaining its promise in providing value for money jewellery to customers.

name: TEVA
description: Ingenuity and the spirit of adventure lies in the heart of Teva, a footwear company founded in the Grand Canyon in 1984. Their iconic sandals have seen three decades of go-getters and globetrotters explore the world over. If you're looking for the free spirit, the spontaneous adventurer, the sense of 'carpe diem'- fret not. Teva is what you've been searching for!

name: THE BODY SHOP
description: In 1976, pioneer Anita Roddick founded The Body Shop with the vision of putting people and planet first, standing up for what's right and being a force for good in the beauty industry. The brand aims to make a positive difference to people's lives. Where possible, it creates products that contain ethically-sourced and natural origin ingredients that make one's skin feel enriched and loved.

name: THE NORTH FACE
description: Founded in 1966 in San Francisco, California, The North Face is the world's premier outdoor brand embodying a spirit that is authentic, innovative as well as technical. The brand carries an extensive range of best-in-class outdoor and performance apparel, equipment, accessories and footwear that will inspire and enable people to never stop exploring.

name: THE OAK CELLARS
description: The Oaks Cellars Pte Ltd was set up in 1996 to keep up with the accelerating demand for the epicurean lifestyle. Today, The Oaks Cellars is an icon in the Singapore Wine business, known for its impeccable service, sound retail and distribution strategies in the management of wine shops.

name: THE ONITSUKA
description: Located at level 1 with an eye-catching facade, THE ONITSUKA boutique's interior was conceived with thoughtful details that showcase the enduring style of the collection. The boutique's colour palette of black, white, and red is at once striking, reductive, and elegant. Discover our latest collection of dress shoes, apparel, and accessories now.

name: THE PLANET TRAVELLER
description: The Planet Traveller is Singapore's largest one-stop travel and lifestyle store, with the widest range of luggage, backpacks, wallets, water bottles, and travel accessories. Discover a wide selection of lifestyle and travel products from renowned international brands like Alpaka, Bellroy, Bric's, Briggs \& Riley, Crossing, Eagle Creek, Echolac, Jansport, July, Knirps, Osprey, Pacsafe, Secrid, Sttoke, Thule and more!

name: THE WHISKY DISTILLERY
description: The Whisky Distillery is the only true whisky-focused specialist based in Singapore. Be marvelled with over 200 whiskies that are meticulously sourced from the best distilleries in Scotland and Japan, including some from closed distilleries. The brand is constantly on the search for new spirits with genuine heritage and high quality to our comprehensive selection. Through its knowledge and passion for this spirit, often referred as "liquid gold", The Whisky Distillery seeks to provide an impeccable and personalised drinking experience with exclusive tasting sessions and private events.

name: TIFFANY & CO.
description: Since 1837, Tiffany \& Co. has been the world's premier jeweller and America's house of design, with a commitment to quality and craftsmanship.

name: TISSOT
description: Always ahead of its time without forgetting its roots is a philosophy to which Tissot has aways adhered, in its products but also in privileged position of being the Official Timekeeper of major sports events all around the world. The Brand's DNA stands around two characteristics: an attachment to authentic traditional values and a desire for innovation. Tissot's wide range of products allows its customers to create memories for every important milestone in life.

name: TOMMY HILFIGER
description: TOMMY HILFIGER is one of the world's most recognised premium lifestyle brands, uplifting and inspiring consumers since 1985. The brand creates iconic style, which comes alive at the intersection of the classic and the new, co-created with people who are shaping culture around the world. TOMMY HILFIGER celebrates the essence of classic American style with a modern twist. Tommy Hilfiger offers premium quality and value to consumers worldwide under the TOMMY HILFIGER and TOMMY JEANS lifestyles, with a breadth of collections including men's, women's and kids' sportswear, denim, accessories, and footwear. Tommy Hilfiger has an unwavering commitment to sustainability and inclusivity.

name: TRIUMPH
description: For over 135 years, Triumph has remained the industry synonym for fit. A renowned German lingerie brand, with strong heritage and expertise in the design and craftmanship.

name: TUDOR
description: TUDOR is an award-winning Swiss-made watch brand, renowned for mechanical watches that blend refined aesthetics, reliability and exceptional value. Flagship collections such as the Black Bay, Pelagos and 1926 reflect the brand's technical excellence and born to dare spirit.
