With a legacy of innovation, TUDOR crafts rugged tool watches and elegant classics for explorers, professionals, and everyday adventurers.

name: TUMI
description: Since 1975, TUMI has been creating world-class business, travel and performance luxury essentials, designed to upgrade, uncomplicate, and beautify all aspects of life on the move. Blending flawless functionality with a spirit of ingenuity, we're committed to empowering journeys as a lifelong partner to movers and makers in pursuit of their passions. The brand is sold globally in over 75 countries with approximately 2,000 points of sale.

name: TYPO
description: Typo: Anything But Ordinary Discover the freshest stationery and gifts; everything you need to create good vibes.

name: UNIQLO
description: About UNIQLO LifeWear Apparel that comes from the Japanese values of simplicity, quality and longevity. Designed to be of the time and for the time, LifeWear is made with such modern elegance that it becomes the building blocks of each individual's style. A perfect shirt is always being made more perfect. The simplest design hides the most thoughtful and modern details. The best in fit and fabric made to be affordable and accessible to all. LifeWear is clothing that is constantly being innovated, bringing more warmth, more lightness, better design, and better comfort to people's lives.

name: V-ZUG
description: Swiss perfection for your home. Since 1913. For more than 100 years, the esteemed Swiss brand has made its mission to design state-of-the-art household appliances that don't compromise on precision, design, sustainability and environmental aspects. Mastery of innovative technologies, intuitive versatility and minimalist design, the Singapore showroom is the perfect place to experience V-ZUG luxurious collection of kitchen and laundry appliances that makes life easier in a reliable and environmentally friendly way.

name: VACHERON CONSTANTIN
description: Founded in 1755, Vacheron Constantin is the world's oldest watch Manufacture in continuous production for nearly 270 years, faithfully perpetuating a proud heritage of watchmaking excellence and stylistic sophistication through generations of master craftsmen. At the pinnacle of Haute Horlogerie and understated elegance, the Maison creates timepieces with unique technical and aesthetic signatures, and an extremely high level of finishing touches.

name: VALENTINO
description: The house of Valentino is based in the heart of Rome, the Eternal City, and expresses a point of view on the contemporary world using history as a playground and the Atelier as a place that produces both beauty and thought. Style is essential and impalpable. The idea of contemporary humanism leads a creative quest that revolves around the personality of the wearer. Vision, products, retail spaces share the same traits: from the one-of-a-kind Haute Couture creations to women's and men's ready-to-wear and accessories, from eyewear to fragrances to the boutiques, Valentino is synonymous of elegance, pureness, craftsmanship, uniqueness.

name: VAN CLEEF & ARPELS
description: Since 1906, Van Cleef \& Arpels has pursued its refined and highly recognisable style imbued with creativity, culture and poetry. The Maison applies its jewelry and watchmaking savoir-faire in a wondrously delicate universe where the most precious materials seem to come to life.

name: VICTORIA'S SECRET AND PINK
description: Victoria's Secret is the world's largest intimates retailer offering a wide assortment of modern collections, including signature bras, panties, lingerie, sleepwear, athleisure, award-winning prestige fragrances and body care. With nearly 1,400 retail stores worldwide and over 25,000 female employees, it has the largest team of specialty trained bra fit experts worldwide. PINK, a lifestyle brand under Victoria's Secret, focuses on community celebration, positive mental health, and environmental kindness. Embracing diversity, equity, and inclusion, PINK offers a range of feel-good products, including loungewear, tops, bras, activewear, accessories, and beauty items.

name: VOM FASS
description: Vom FASS offers the finest selection of fruit vinegars, exquisite oils, exclusive liqueurs and a wide choice of spirits, all bought from tap.

name: WATSONS
description: Discover health \& beauty brands at Watsons Singapore, including new products for skincare, cosmetics, personal care and more.

name: WILSON
description: Founded in 1914 in Chicago, Illinois, Wilson Sporting Goods Co. is a leading manufacturer of high-performance sports equipment, apparel, footwear, and accessories. With more than a century of innovation, history, and heritage across multiple sports, including tennis, baseball, padel, football, basketball, volleyball, pickleball, and golf, Wilson's equipment, game balls and apparel are thoughtfully designed and developed to empower athletes at every level around the world to perform at their best.

name: YVES SAINT LAURENT BEAUTE
description: Known for their bold and iconic approach to makeup and fragrances, YSL Beauté continues to push the boundaries of beauty and celebrate freedom of expression. It asserts itself as a collection of icons, with each creation driven by boldness, youth, and the avant-garde.

name: ZARA
description: ZARA is a forward-thinking force in fashion; embodying what is possible when responsibility and aspiration are accessible to all. By bringing more thoughtful style to the world, we aim to provide everyone with the inspiringly beautiful, always on-trend, responsibly crafted fashion they deserve.

name: ZOFF
description: Zoff eyewear is a new era of style and joy. Beyond clear vision, our glasses inspire excitement and personal expression. Priced from S$128, our diverse range invites you to have fun, switch styles, and transform your identity effortlessly. Discover the joy of Zoff glasses today!

name: TALAD THAI BANANA ตลาดไทย
description: Talad Thai Banana is an Authentic Thai recipe crafted with love. Their unique batter is made from the freshest ingredients prepared daily with love and good intentions. All products are vegetarian friendly and in fresh batches daily.

name: GATTEN SUSHI
description: This renowned Japanese institution redefines the conveyor belt experience through a sophisticated lens of culinary excellence and artisanal precision. At Gatten Sushi, the kaiten concept is transformed into a theatre of freshness. Eschewing the ordinary, their chefs utilise time-honoured Edomae techniques to prepare market-fresh, seasonal seafood sourced directly from Japan's finest purveyors. Each plate is a curated masterpiece, offering a seamless blend of traditional craftsmanship and contemporary flair.

name: TAI CHEONG BAKERY
description: Established in 1954, Tai Cheong Bakery was started by egg tart Master Au Yeung's uncle, who later handed down the business to Au Yeung. He then pioneered the cookie crust for egg tarts using skills picked up while working in western style kitchens. Tai Cheong gained popularity with locals and foreigners alike, reaching its peak when Chris Patten (then governor of Hong Kong) started frequenting the original outlet at Lyndhurst Street.

name: KYO WATAMI
description: At Kyo Watami, their grilled dishes celebrate the comforting flavours that keep guests coming back, inspired by the timeless taste of Japanese izakayas. Focusing on skewered grills, each item is carefully cooked one by one, with precise heat control tailored to the character of every ingredient. At the heart of this flavour is their signature sauce, refined and perfected over many years. We pay close attention to the balance of sweetness, richness, and smokiness, creating a taste that naturally complements every skewer. From classic yakitori to meat-wrapped skewers and seafood varieties, their diverse lineup is another hallmark of Kyo Watami. Unpretentious, yet deeply satisfying --- these are grilled dishes crafted to be genuinely delicious.

name: OSTERIA MOZZA
description: Where rustic Italian tradition meets the sophisticated energy of modern dining, Osteria Mozza stands as a global icon of culinary excellence. Co-founded by the legendary Nancy Silverton, this Michelin-starred destination reimagines the classic Italian osteria through a lens of premium ingredients, artisanal craft, and a vibrant, soulful atmosphere.

name: 1-ATICO BY 1-ALTITUDE
description: Enter a new dimension 218m in the sky at 1-ATICO, Singapore's latest 'penthouse' destination with spectacular panoramic views over the city. 1-ATICO is home to 3 distinct social experiences, from Argentinian restaurant FIRE to a Japanese-Peruvian influenced restaurant FLNT and an ultimate eponymously ATICO Lounge.

name: 108 MATCHA SARO
description: 108 Matcha Saro originates from Asahikawa, Hokkaido, ensures quality ingredients that include Uji Matcha powder from Kyoto as well as Taiwan's Pingtung Wandan red bean used in its well-loved Obanyaki and Parfait. The other signature consists of the mouth-watering Warabi Mochi and Soft Serve cone which is vegetarian friendly. It is suitable for people of different dietary to enjoy.

name: 7-ELEVEN
description: 7-Eleven is the store of choice for a wide range of on-the-go needs, top-ups and bill payment services.

name: AWFULLY CHOCOLATE
description: Famed for its artisanal dark chocolate, Awfully Chocolate's boutique features a premium collection of handcrafted chocolate bars, cookies \& gift sets.

name: BACHA COFFEE
description: The story of Bacha Coffee begins in 1910 in Marrakech at the spectacular Dar el Bacha. Today, Bacha Coffee offers the largest selection of specialty coffees in the world and the unique opportunity to travel the world through your cup by exploring over 200 varieties of 100% Arabica specialty coffees from 35 of the most well-reputed producing countries. Select from an exquisite collection of loose coffee beans in bespoke grinds to suit any brewing preference, freshly packed in beautiful canisters or prepared in signature single-serve coffee bags. Explore timeless coffee accessories to elevate coffee moments or give as exquisite gifts. Indulge in an all-day dining experience in the elegance of a coffee room inspired by the brand's birthplace with sumptuous gourmet dishes accompanied by a ballet of elegant service.

name: BAO BAO
description: Unwrapping a taste of heritage, where tradition meets your cravings.

name: BENGAWAN SOLO
description: With over 30 years of history, Bengawan Solo has become a household name for kueh, cakes and local cookies known for its homemade quality.

name: BOOST
description: Boost offers a healthy alternative featuring delicious smoothies, juices and crushes, all developed with the assistance of a nutritionist.

name: BREADTALK
description: BreadTalk is a distinctive, award-winning Singapore brand that has gained international appeal. It is renowned for the way it has revolutionised the culture of bread consumption with its visually appealing and creative products.

name: CAFE NESUTO
description: Nesuto, is an atelier of exquisite confectionery. Dedicated to crafting desserts that celebrate both simplicity and significance, with a deep emphasis on quality ingredients and thoughtful details. Each product is designed to evoke a sense of connection, comfort, and quiet indulgence. A new page is turning, as we set the table for you again. The hoarding will soon come down, making way for gatherings filled with lightness and the familiar comfort of something beautifully made.

name: CANTON PARADISE+
description: Born from the love of Hong Kong's bustling food scene, Canton Paradise+ offers all-day H.K. style dim sum, congee and H.K. noodle, lovingly handmade and thoughtfully presented. Indulge in the authentic taste of Hong Kong, crafted meticulously with creativity.

name: CINNABON
description: Founded in Seattle in 1985, Cinnabon serves fresh, aromatic, oven-hot cinnamon rolls in different flavours, as well as a variety of other baked goods and specialty beverages.

name: COMMON MAN COFFEE ROASTERS ON THE GO
description: Presenting the perfect caffeinated antidote, Common Man Coffee Roasters On The Go is a snug little enclave that offers specialty coffee brews, with a petite nourishing selection of sandwiches and pastries to curb those on-the-go cravings.

name: DONQ EDITER/MINI ONE
description: Enjoy a wide selection of artisanal breads at DONQ ÉDITER's first store to open outside of Japan. Complementing DONQ's fresh bakes is MiniOne providing a delightful array of grab-and-go treats, from mini croissants to mochi and cheesecakes. DONQ is a beloved Japanese bakery, renowned for its "onsite-scratch baking method" which means performing the entire baking process from scratch in-store, bringing the authentic taste of France with the uncompromising quality of Japan.

name: DUNKIN' DONUTS
description: Dunkin' is Singapore's favourite coffee \& baked goods quick-service restaurant brand, serving up freshly-made handcrafted beverages, scrumptious donuts and bakery items every day.

name: EACH A CUP
description: Originating from Taiwan, Each-a Cup features healthy and quality bubble tea beverages at affordable prices.

name: EU YAN SANG
description: Since 1879, Eu Yan Sang has been a leading brand in the health \& wellness space, with an established reputation in Traditional Chinese Medicine.

name: FIVE GUYS
description: FIVE GUYS has been offering customizable burgers, fries, shakes and hotdogs since 1986. Did you know there are 250000 combinations and that all toppings and mix-ins are free? Fresh, fun and handmade.

name: FOOD OPERA
description: Food Opera offers an elegant ambiance with a multitude of delicious Singapore heritage dishes to create a unique \& nostalgic dining experience. \*This store accepts payment of eCapitaVouchers, except via the ION Orchard mobile app.

name: GUZMAN Y GOMEZ MEXICAN KITCHEN
description: At Guzman y Gomez, their passion is creating delicious 100% CLEAN Mexican food using only the highest quality ingredients. Try the GYG Mexican food experience in Singapore today!

name: HANG HEUNG HONG KONG
description: Established in 1920 as a Chinese-style restaurant in Hong Kong, Hang Heung now has a history of 100 years. Hang Heung's first Flagship Store in Singapore features several popular products, such as its signature Wife Cake, award-winning Handmade Egg Rolls, Cookies as well as other Traditional Snacks.

name: HAWKERS' STREET
description: Hawkers' Street is a concept created to bring all of our favourite and famed hawkers, including Michelin-accredited brands nearer to all Singaporeans to ensure the continuity of our hawker dining habits by placing them under one roof. Last order at 9pm.

name: HEYTEA
description: HEYTEA created the first-ever Cheezo Tea and has since injected new life into traditional Chinese tea by adding fruits and other ingredients.

name: HOSHINO COFFEE
description: Hoshino Coffee, originally from Japan, is known for its aromatic hand drip coffee and soufflé pancake. Aside from the signature coffees and desserts, Hoshino offers a wide variety of wafu pasta, rice dishes and sides. It's the perfect place to dine whether you're looking for some coffee, a light bite, or a satisfying meal!

name: IMPERIAL TREASURE FINE TEOCHEW CUISINE
description: With its mellow, refined flavours and wholesome preparation methods, Teochew cuisine requires utmost skill and attention to detail. Signatures dishes such as Steamed Diced Abalone wrapped with Egg White Skin, Steamed Coral Trout in Teochew Style and Chilled Australian Lobster are guaranteed to win you over.

name: IMPERIAL TREASURE HUAIYANG CUISINE
description: Imperial Treasure Huaiyang Cuisine focuses on top-notch culinary techniques featuring characteristics of the Huai and Yang regions in China. Great emphasis is placed on knife skills with meticulous cutting techniques while preserving the natural flavours and colours of each dish.

name: JASONS DELI
description: At Jasons Deli, we believe that good food is one of life's simple pleasures. We aim to provide fresh provisions and healthy indulgences at your convenience while reducing waste for a greener earth.

name: JUMBO SEAFOOD
description: Savour JUMBO Seafood's iconic Award-Winning Chilli Crab whilst taking in the panoramic view of Orchard Road. Or take break from the hustle and bustle to enjoy dim sum or an Afternoon Sea Experience, made entirely of dainty sea delicacies only available exclusively at JUMBO Seafood ION Orchard.

name: KOI THE
description: KOI THÉ Singapore was first established in 2007 with the vision to bring happiness to the world when they drink a cup of tea. THÉ means "TEA" in French, its pronunciation also sounds like Taiwanese "TÉ" in KOI. KOI's Milk Tea is irresistible with a variety of outstanding toppings and exclusive flavors that differentiate us from the rest. As Singapore's renowned bubble tea brand, KOI focuses on brewing aromatic tea with quality. The freshly brewed tea and flavourful ingredients, prepared with passion are the key to KOI's authentic taste. KOI shares its happiness and love of tea with everyone, making every experience memorable.

name: LÄDERACH (LADERACH)
description: Enjoy pure delight with every bite from Läderach Switzerland, an authentic Swiss family heritage brand founded in 1962. Handcrafted with love and artfully designed by Swiss chocolatiers, Läderach's chocolates are air flown from Switzerland to Singapore to ensure maximum freshness. Today, the Läderach family continues to pursue their passion and commitment to creating luxury Swiss chocolates made from the best ingredients and enjoyed across generations.

name: LAVENDER
description: From copper-cooked jams to no-filler sausages, it is our everyday goal to produce foods that will not only nourish your body but also delight your senses, leaving you a wonderful memory. We love to create with our team, derive pleasures from our products and share the joy with our customers. It is our hope you have a feast for your eyes every time you step into any of our brick and mortar, a pleasant surprise every time you bite into our many creations. When your heart beats a little faster, you will have enjoyed the Lavender experience.

name: LEE WEE & BROTHERS
description: A local household brand synonymous with quality otah, Lee Wee \& Brothers takes pride in emphasizing traditional recipes and methods. Having been around since 2000, the homegrown chain earns a reputation for delivering the most original, authentic and sophisticated taste of Singapore -- the taste of the good ol' days.

name: LETAO / TOKYO MILK CHEESE FACTORY
description: LeTAO: Established in Otaru, Japan in 1998 and is famous for its two-layered cheesecakes. Phone number: 87993551 TMCF: Established in Japan in 2011, Tokyo Milk Cheese Factory is well-known for its Cheese Cookies made with the finest ingredients from Japan and around the world. Phone number: 92488475

name: LIM CHEE GUAN
description: Crafting Exquisite Bak Kwa Since 1938 With over eight decades of tradition, Lim Chee Guan is Singapore's foremost authority in crafting delectable bak kwa. Our passion and expertise passed down through generations, elevate this culinary delight to an unrivalled gastronomic experience. Carefully selected slices marinated with family culinary legacy, lovingly roasted over glowing charcoal - our bak kwa preparation is a labor of love, ensuring perfect balance and juicy perfection in every bite. A traditional snacks that is an essential part of any celebration. Indulge in our authentic taste, preserved through generations of dedication and expertise. Create lasting memories with Lim Chee Guan, your trusted purveyor of Singapore's finest bak kwa since 1938.

name: MARUTAMA RAMEN
description: On 1 April 2001, just one day before his 40th birthday, founder Tetsuya Kudo established MARUTAMA RA-MEN in Kawaguchi, Japan. Kudo's goal was to create ramen that could be enjoyed by people worldwide. Chicken is a universal food found in almost every culture. This inspired the creation of MARUTAMA RA-MEN's signature creamy chicken broth, known as toripaitan. Since its inception, the ramen has been enjoyed by many in Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Canada, and Australia. The company continues to seek to share its ramen with more people from diverse backgrounds and cultures. In 2007, MARUTAMA RA-MEN came to Singapore for the first time, offering its creamy broth experience to a new audience. Expansion is currently underway.

name: MONSTER CURRY
description: Embarking on a journey since 2012 with Monster Curry's signature demi-glace Japanese curry sauce while pushing the boundaries to your imagination. From a classic katsu curry rice to monster curry burger, even vegetarian options.

name: MOS JAPANESE FINE FOODS
description: MOS Japanese Fine Foods is a premium Japanese hamburger chain restaurant which offers a wide variety of unique and original tasting burgers. To ensure that our products are of the finest, the healthiest and the freshest quality, we use more vegetables for the burgers and we hand prepared the vegetables every morning instead of pre-packed the vegetables in factory. Every burger is prepared only upon customers' order to ensure that customer can enjoy the flavour of the burger to the fullest.

name: OLD CHANG KEE
description: For over half a century, Singaporeans from all walks of life have enjoyed Old Chang Kee's signature Curry'O -- a crispy pastry shell generously stuffed with curried potato, chicken and an egg slice, all cooked with special herbs and spices. Old Chang Kee also offers other delectable hot snacks and lip-smacking quick bites. Embracing the wonderful traditions and noble heritage of Singapore, Old Chang Kee strives to bring to their customers the good old tastes that all come to love since 1956.

name: PARIS BAGUETTE
description: Born from a love of bread and a passion for quality, Paris Baguette is an international, fast-casual bakery specializing in French-inspired goods. In addition to chef-inspired cakes, pastries, sandwiches, salads and signature coffee and tea, we offer a unique experience to thousands of guests daily.

name: PLAIN VANILLA
description: Plain Vanilla ION Orchard is an unexpected oasis of calm along the busiest shopping strip in the city. Here, you'll find its signature cupcakes, viennoiseries and bakes, a selection of fresh sandwiches and salads from the deli, aromatic organic coffee and tea and a curated selection of homeware.

name: POCHA! KOREAN STREET DINING
description: A faithful recreation of all the best that Korean street dining has to offer. Come as one for a friendly meal, or with family and friends to enjoy a feast.

name: POULET + BRASSERIE
description: Poulet + Brasserie is a modern French-themed bistro offering affordable French classics to the mass public since 2012. The French Roast Chicken maestro serves freshly roasted chicken that are brined overnight using an in-house secret recipe. The Poulet Roti is complemented with signature sauces: delicious homemade Mushroom Cream Sauce, Diane Sauce, Cranberry Sauce and Black Pepper Sauce. Poulet + Brasserie presents itself as the perfect place for any occasion worth celebrating, with something for everyone to savour and indulge in.

name: PUZZLE COFFEE
description: Created and designed in Melbourne, we are a socially responsible bean to cup artisan coffee house that offers specialty coffee with a focus on creating a better world with coffee, one piece at a time. Sourcing only the very best fairly traded speciality coffee beans from farmers around the world, a visit to Puzzle will be sure to complete your day.

name: ROYCE'
description: Established in 1983 in Hokkaido, ROYCE' chocolates have been available in Singapore since 2001.

name: RIVE GAUCHE PATISSERIE
description: Southern Bank of Seine River which houses the rich arts \& cultural of France. Naturally creative \& inspired by Seine's rich cultures in year 1993, our pastries-loving Founder set out to perfect a French artisan patisserie which delivered only quality hand fluffed \& tastefully crafted cakes to the refined taste buds in Asia.

name: SANOOK KITCHEN
description: Sanook Kitchen Thai BBQ \& Seafood is a casual dining concept offering Thai-style BBQ and Thai classics. Choose from an array of seafood to meat items that are grilled perfectly, served with house-made Thai dipping sauces. Diners can also savour a wide variety of appetisers, soup, curries and more.

name: SEN-RYO
description: Experience the exquisite flavours of sen-ryo, where traditional Japanese craftsmanship meets innovative culinary artistry, featuring an extensive selection of expertly crafted sushi and sashimi, alongside a range of delectable Japanese dishes.

name: STARBUCKS COFFEE
description: Since 1971, Starbucks Coffee Company has been committed to ethically sourcing and roasting high quality arabica coffee. Today, with stores around the globe, the company is the premier roaster and retailer of specialty coffee in the world. Through our unwavering commitment to excellence and our guiding principles, we bring the unique Starbucks Experience to life for every customer through every cup.

name: SUPER SUSHI
description: Super Sushi believes in serving fresh and delicious sushi. Their commitment to using only fresh, never frozen, salmon and the finest Niigata rice, along with specially made red vinegar rice prepared fresh in-store, ensures an unparalleled sushi experience. Explore their innovative sushi creations that artfully blend tradition with unique flavors---each bite is a testament to their dedication to delight customers through quality and creativity.

name: SURREY HILLS GROCER
description: Established in December 2021, Surrey Hills Grocer is a homegrown grocer and one-stop lifestyle and dining destination that brings authentic Australian farm gate and gourmet experience to Singapore. The unique concept combines various features across its outlets, which may include a café, gourmet marketplace, bakery, and cocktail bar, that offers shoppers differentiated experiences and access to premium, artisanal and sustainable goods at an affordable price.

name: TASTE PARADISE
description: Taste Paradise offers an elaborate menu of traditional Cantonese cuisine with an innovative touch, and embraces the culture of wine pairing with over 200 exquisite labels, all in an elegant contemporary setting to delight diners.

name: TEMPURA TENDON TENYA
description: Tenya is Japan's No.1 Tendon Chain Restaurant. Tenya Singapore endeavours to bring the best dining experience to our customers through the offering of sustainably-sourced premium quality ingredients and impeccable service. The brand exists to bring Japan's food culture to a whole new standard.

name: THE 1872 CLIPPER TEA CO.
description: The 1872 Clipper Tea Co. is Singapore's specialty tea blender dedicated to crafting refined tea blends from farm-to-cup. Founded in 1872, they pay homage to the historic clipper ships that brought the freshest teas around the world. They are dedicated to sourcing the specialty tea leaves sustainably and crafting exceptional blends with refined flavour.

name: THE MARMALADE PANTRY
description: Since 1999, The Marmalade Pantry has been a beloved modern café bistro known for its hearty pastas, fresh salads, and signature cakes. The flagship outlet at ION Orchard now shines anew with a refreshed interior that is full of character, and communal corners designed to bring people together. Look forward to new citrus accents in the menu, alongside your familiar favourites and flavours you love.

name: THE SOUP SPOON
description: We travel the world, discovering its cultures, one bowl of soup at a time. From the world, to our kitchen, to you.

name: TOAST BOX
description: Toast Box is a Singaporean contemporary coffee chain rooted in the recreation of Nanyang coffee and toast culture popular during the 1960s and 70s. Step inside and be greeted by the fragrance of coffee made from freshly-ground caramelised coffee beans, complemented by a menu of familiar home favourites.

name: TORI-Q
description: Enjoy the authentic taste of Japanese yakitori made using only the finest ingredients.

name: TWG TEA
description: Discover over 1,000 single estate fine harvests teas and indulge in savoury recipes and handcrafted patisseries that are infused with our signature teas.

name: TWYST
description: Twyst is a fast casual F\&B concept offering a delectable range of freshly cooked pasta at affordable price points. Twyst food provides the unexpected twist that gives a delightful surprise, because of their no-holds-barred innovative approach towards flavours that are familiar yet sinfully good.

name: VENCHI
description: With more than 145 years' worth of history, Venchi embodies the essence of the Italian lifestyle and brings delightful flavors worldwide. Over the years, Venchi has earned global acclaim for its unwavering dedication to craftsmanship and excellence. It has established a global presence, with stores in 70 countries and over 150 outlets worldwide.

name: VIOLET OON SINGAPORE
description: Embark on an enchanting all-day dining experience, featuring a retail selection that breathes life into a treasury of original recipes. Immerse yourself in a symphony of local favourites and Nyonya signatures, each meticulously crafted to capture the essence of Singapore's culinary heritage.

name: YA KUN KAYA TOAST
description: From its humble beginnings as a modest coffee stall in the 1940s, the name of Ya Kun has become synonymous with unparalleled kaya toast and irresistibly fragrant coffee and tea, enjoyed amidst a cosy atmosphere. Today, Ya Kun continues to delight and attract fans from all walks of life both in Singapore and around the world.
